name: Yuornis
sum: Toothless Late Cretaceous enantiornithean from Henan, China, close to Gobipteryx.
holotype: A skeleton from Henan (number in Xu et al. 2021).
biology: Toothless like Gobipteryx, its sister taxon in Xu et al. (2021).
author: Xu et al. 2021

sources.text: Xu, Li; Buffetaut, Eric; O’Connor, Jingmai; Zhang, Xingliao; Jia, Songhai; Zhang, Jiming; Chang, Huali; Tong, Haiyan Nove. A new, remarkably preserved, enantiornithine bird from the Upper Cretaceous Qiupa Formation of Henan (central China) and convergent evolution between enantiornitheans and modern birds. Geological Magazine 158(11): 2087–2094. doi:10.1017/S0016756821000807
